mapper.select: SELECT NVL(SUM(register_count), 0) AS registerCount, NVL(SUM(payment_count), 0) AS paymentCount, NVL(SUM(refund_count), 0) AS refundCount FROM TR_WIN_STAT_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT age_group AS ageGroup, NVL(SUM(patient_count), 0) AS patientCount FROM TR_WIN_STAT_AGE WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY age_group
SELECT time_slot AS timeSlot, NVL(SUM(business_count), 0) AS businessCount FROM TR_WIN_STAT_TM WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY time_slot ORDER BY time_slot
SELECT source_name AS sourceName, NVL(SUM(source_count), 0) AS sourceCount FROM TR_WIN_STAT_SRC WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY source_name ORDER BY sourceCount DESC

SELECT business_type AS businessType, NVL(SUM(register_count), 0) AS registerCount, NVL(SUM(payment_count), 0) AS paymentCount, NVL(SUM(refund_count), 0) AS refundCount FROM TR_WIN_STAT_LOAD WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY business_type ORDER BY business_type
